question.prompt: Point \(P\) lies inside \(\angle AOB\), and its distances to \(OA\) and \(OB\) are both \(5\). If \(\angle AOB=60^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle AOP\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: Since \(P\) is equidistant from the two sides of the angle and lies inside it, \(OP\) bisects \(\angle AOB\), so \(\angle AOP=60^\circ\div2=30^\circ\).
solutions.title: Identify the bisector and halve the angle
